policy: User-reviewed revision: a single HSB transform across the whole frame bitmap, including paper, for every material. Equal frame/paper weight; bounded Huber fit on calibration medians. Same reserved cohorts reused, so this is an iterative study, not a fresh blind validation. Mana fitted separately by set/symbol using fixed eroded discs; no per-scan alignment. Global set fit is compared across six nonland materials. White texture was visually confirmed; contrast spread alone is not an asset mismatch.
